summary: kie-pp-mcp's http transport must default to a loopback bind (127.0.0.1:7777), not all-interfaces (:7777); a reprint that regenerates cmd/kie-pp-mcp/main.go with a bare-port default reintroduces an unauthenticated network listener exposing credentialed API and local SQLite tools to any reachable client.
reason: server.NewStreamableHTTPServer as wired here performs no client authentication. A bare ':7777' default binds every interface, so any host that can reach the port gets full access to credentialed Kie.ai API calls and local learn/store data with zero auth. --addr remains available for an intentional wider bind (e.g. a container's 0.0.0.0:7777).
validated_outcome: go build ./... passes; --addr flag still overrides the default for callers that intentionally want a non-loopback bind.
